name: Hedera Swiss Franc
oneLiner: HCHF is HLiquity's Swiss-franc stablecoin on Hedera, minted from overcollateralized HBAR troves via Liquity-style borrowing and Stability Pool liquidations.
collateral: HBAR locked in overcollateralized HLiquity Troves on Hedera, with a 110% minimum collateral ratio and Stability Pool liquidations
pegMechanism: Liquity-style borrowing protocol on Hedera: users mint HCHF debt against HBAR collateral, undercollateralized Troves are liquidated through the Stability Pool, and HCHF can be redeemed for HBAR collateral at face value to support the CHF peg

oracleRisk.summary: HLiquity PriceFeed uses Pyth as primary and Supra as fallback for HBAR/CHF pricing, with frozen/broken/deviation checks and last-good-price behavior.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Hedera token metadata has no admin, freeze, wipe, or pause key. The non-null supply_key supports protocol minting against HBAR collateral in HLiquity's Liquity-style CDP system rather than a privileged holder-freeze or unbounded admin-mint path.

sources.label: Hedera Mirror Node HCHF token state

mintAuthority.summary: HCHF is minted only when immutable HLiquity BorrowerOperations creates user debt against HBAR Troves. The HTS supply key decodes to fixed HCHFToken contract 0.0.6070122 rather than an external keypair, and that wrapper accepts mint calls only from fixed BorrowerOperations 0.0.6070094. The token has no admin, freeze, KYC, wipe, pause, fee, or metadata key, and every mint-critical contract has renounced ownership with no contract-update history.

controls.label: HLiquity HCHFToken and fixed BorrowerOperations mint path
controls.capDescription: No hard global supply cap. BorrowerOperations permits user debt only under the immutable 110% minimum collateral ratio, 150% critical collateral ratio, 1,780-HCHF minimum net debt, 20-HCHF gas compensation, and 0.5% borrowing-fee floor; HTS also applies its signed-int64 per-call bound.
controls.evidence: At Hedera block 97626563, token 0.0.6070123 had no admin, freeze, KYC, wipe, pause, fee, or metadata key. Its sole supply-key protobuf decoded to ContractID 0.0.6070122, also the token treasury. Exact HCHFToken source permits only fixed BorrowerOperations 0.0.6070094 to call mint. HCHFToken, BorrowerOperations, TroveManager, StabilityPool, and PriceFeed each had owner() = 0, self-referential ContractID admin keys, no modified timestamp, and no CONTRACTUPDATEINSTANCE history. Transaction 0.0.842806-1783066707-152111688 at block 97172682 traces a user adjustTrove through BorrowerOperations and HCHFToken into HTS mintToken, confirming the live path.

review.evidence: At the fixed cutoff, historical Mirror Node state and contract calls resolved the full HCHF mint path. The token's sole supply key is fixed wrapper contract 0.0.6070122, not an external signer; exact source restricts wrapper mint to fixed BorrowerOperations 0.0.6070094. All five checked mint, collateral, liquidation, and oracle contracts had renounced owners and no external update history. A real mint trace at block 97172682 follows user Trove adjustment through BorrowerOperations into the HTS mint precompile.
